title: Reflection AI announces Beam
summary: A 501B-parameter open-weight model from Reflection AI, positioned as a Western alternative for developers and coding agents.

title: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2
summary: An open multimodal embedding model for search and retrieval. Perplexity also opened its pplx-embed-v2 model the same week.

title: Nous Research raises $90M for Hermes for Businesses
summary: The team behind the open-source Hermes agent announced an enterprise product. The company says Hermes has been cloned more than 24 million times.

title: Mistral Large 4 enters public preview
summary: A roughly 1T-parameter multimodal model. Open weights are promised for the end of October but are not released yet.

title: Command A+ listed as a new open-source model
summary: A model release tracker lists Command A+ as a new open-source release. Check the vendor's page for license terms.

title: GLM-5.3 FlashX listed as a new open-source model
summary: The same tracker lists this GLM variant as open source. Confirm license and weights on the vendor's page before use.

title: Apertus 1.5 is active
summary: The Swiss fully open, multilingual LLM from ETH Zurich, EPFL and CSCS reached version 1.5 under the Apache 2.0 license.
